outputs.explanation: Panel A shows horizontal bar-style timing diagrams (camera exposure time vs illumination overhead) with a single calculated percentage per condition, not an average of independent replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Line/decay-curve plot of normalized fluorescence intensity across frames (mean±s.e.m. shading); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with a fitted trend line; classified as a scatter plot, which is exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Migration track plots showing individual cell trajectories as lines (X-Y position); this is a line-plot type display, exempt from the requirement, and in fact already shows individual cell tracks.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) with individual cell data points overlaid as black dots for each condition.
Panel F consists of micrographs (MitoTracker/Paxillin images and merges), not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel G is a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
